entities.summary: Daishen Feao Nix is an American professional basketball player for the Rio Grande Valley Vipers of the NBA G League. He was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the best point guards in the 2020 class. A former UCLA signee, Nix bypassed playing college basketball and joined the NBA G League Ignite. At the high school level, he competed for Trinity International School in Las Vegas, Nevada.
